name: evidence-first
description: Evidence-based investigation and reporting workflows for ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Verify claims with explicit evidence coverage.
interface.longDescription: Investigate claims to the depth required by the conclusion, distinguish verified facts from synthesis and unknowns, and report evidence coverage before confidence.
defaultPrompt: Investigate this claim and separate verified facts, synthesis, conflicts, and unknowns.
Audit whether this item can be deleted safely and show the evidence coverage.
Verify this report against current artifacts, history, and authoritative sources.
